manual_requirement.question: Is the kubelet eventRecordQPS set to a level that ensures appropriate event capture?
manual_requirement.title: Kubelet eventRecordQPS is appropriate
manual_requirement.guidance: Review eventRecordQPS in the kubelet configuration: CIS accepts 0 (unlimited) or a level that still captures events; Prowler fails 0. Record the chosen value and rationale.

prowler.kubernetes.kubelet_event_record_.reason: Upstream sources disagree on whether 0 is acceptable and the Prowler implementation reads streamingConnectionIdleTimeout instead of eventRecordQPS; a deterministic native would produce false positives, so the question is kept as an attestation.

source_review.native_unit: Kubernetes object in the selected cluster/namespace
